title: Run and record an approved change
responsibility: Runs the selected agent with the approved design and records its public reply and observed changes, leaving verification pending.

inputs.name: changeExecute.context
inputs.description: The prepared Change context: selected runner, request with approval, entity, project directory and revision, planning access, cancellation signal and event callback. Approval is assumed already checked.

inputs.name: changeExecute.options
inputs.description: A temporary directory for the first approved image, when one exists, and a callback to observe file paths reported by the runner.

inputs.name: recordChange.context
inputs.description: The same run context used to identify the entity, thread, approval, branch and public reply when recording the outcome.

inputs.name: recordChange.outcome
inputs.type: { before: SourceSnapshot; host: ReturnType<typeof hostChanges>; failure: Error | null; }
inputs.description: The before-change source snapshot, host-operation recorder and failure or null. These determine changed files, observed host operations and completed, failed or cancelled status.

outputs.name: changeExecute
outputs.description: A promise that completes without a return value after the runner finishes. Emits progress and public text, retains the reply for recording and supplies write access with the approved reference image when present. It does not run verification.

outputs.name: recordChange
outputs.description: A promise that completes after comparing source snapshots, recording host operations, emitting changed files and appending an agent message to the thread. The message retains up to 20,000 characters of reply, counts changed files and host operations, names known owning units and states that verification is pending.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown when the cancellation signal is aborted after the runner returns; runner cancellation can also propagate. Recording marks an aborted or cancelled run as cancelled.
